# Oxford Learner's Dictionaries

> > Comprehensive English language learning resource from Oxford University Press, featuring the Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary with detailed word definitions, pronunciations, usage notes, and the Oxford 3000 word list.

Oxford Learner's Dictionaries provides authoritative English language reference materials for learners worldwide, including the Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary and Oxford Advanced American Dictionary. The platform features detailed entries with pronunciations, usage notes, word origins, and specialized vocabulary across academic, medical, and technical domains, supported by corpus-based research like the British National Corpus and the OPAL (Oxford Phrasal Academic Lexicon) framework.

## Key Topics

- Oxford Advanced Learner's Dictionary
- OPAL (Oxford Phrasal Academic Lexicon)
- Oxford 3000 word list
- Pronunciation guides
- Usage notes and examples
- Word origins and etymology
- British and American English
- Academic vocabulary
- Medical terminology
- Grammar reference
- Practical English Usage
- British National Corpus
- English language learning
- Word families and derivatives

## Learning Resources & Word Lists

- [About the Oxford 3000 word list](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/about/oxford3000.html): Essential guide to the Oxford 3000 word list, a core vocabulary selection based on British National Corpus data for English learners

## Core Vocabulary - High Frequency Words

- [according to](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/according-to): OPAL-marked preposition with comprehensive usage notes and examples
- [aboard](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/aboard): Common adverb with detailed pronunciation guide and usage contexts
- [accumulate](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accumulate): OPAL-marked verb with word family and usage examples
- [academic (noun)](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/academic_2): Noun form with etymology tracing to Plato and academic contexts
- [abdomen](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abdomen): Anatomy term with pronunciation and medical usage notes

## Specialized & Technical Vocabulary

- [accident and emergency](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accident-and-emergency): British medical terminology for emergency hospital departments
- [absolute magnitude](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/absolute-magnitude): Astronomy term with technical definition and scientific context
- [ablation](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/ablation): Medical and geological term with specialized usage in multiple fields
- [aconite](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/aconite): Botanical term for a plant genus with poisonous properties
- [twenty-twenty vision](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/twenty-twenty-vision): Eyesight and vision terminology with medical context

## General Vocabulary & Common Terms

- [acceptably](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/acceptably): Adverb with usage notes and examples in context
- [ably](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/ably_1): Adverb with word family connections and derivatives
- [abridged](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/abridged): Adjective commonly used for shortened texts and adaptations
- [achcha](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/achcha): Indian English exclamation with cultural and regional usage notes

## Cultural & Historical References

- [the abdication crisis](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/the-abdication-crisis): Historical event involving Edward VIII, Wallis Simpson, and George VI
- [A & P](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/a-p): American supermarket chain company name and cultural reference

## Optional - Specialized & Literary Terms

- [acidulous](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/acidulous): Formal adjective with Latin origin, used in literary contexts
- [accursed](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/accursed): Old-fashioned adjective with archaic and literary usage
- [ableist](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/ableist): Contemporary term related to disability discrimination and social justice
